59331: São José do Vale do Rio Preto

it.txt: Presidente da Câmara Municipal, assumiu a prefeitura de forma interina em 11/09/2026, com a assinatura da ata de posse, depois que a Justiça Eleitoral cassou os mandatos do prefeito Luciano Pinto da Silva e do vice eleitos em 2024. Na eleição suplementar de 25/10/2026, foram eleitos Felipe Valim (MDB), prefeito, e Alemão do Mercado (PSDB), vice; eles tomam posse depois da diplomação pela Justiça Eleitoral.
it.txt_en: As president of the City Council, she became acting mayor on September 11, 2026, when the record of her swearing-in was signed, after the Electoral Courts revoked the terms of Mayor Luciano Pinto da Silva and the vice mayor elected in 2024. In the special election held on October 25, 2026, Felipe Valim (MDB) was elected mayor and Alemão do Mercado (PSDB) vice mayor; they take office after being certified by the Electoral Courts.
